## Standard Proposal

This template is for changes that propose or modify a section of the AI Product Engineering Standard. Smaller changes (typos, clarifications) should use a regular Pull Request instead.

<!-- One paragraph: what change is being proposed, where in the standard, and why. -->

<!-- What is wrong, missing, or unclear in the current standard? -->
